curated-dafont-pixel-operator-work-sans: Chunky terminal nostalgia up top, with Pixel Operator's fixed-width blocks. Work Sans underneath has open c tips and a high mean line, so it feels current enough for, say, settings toggles.
curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Crayon on rough paper, more or less. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre earns its place big and short, while Tsukimi Rounded, whose rims match its stems, wouldn't carry lengthy blocks of text.
curated-gf-jersey-10-charted-gf-noto-nas: Jersey 10 Charted is tightly drawn and snugly spaced, all display swagger. Noto Nastaliq Urdu keeps a tight vertical rhythm with little ascender height, dignified and best kept to brief text.
curated-gf-kapakana-gf-spectral-sc: Loose handwriting over a bookish backbone. Kapakana does best with closed, nearly merging letter pairs, while Spectral SC, with sturdy hairlines and open mouths, does best when only a couple of lines are needed.
